activities.name: Start_ingest_pipeline Script
activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_incr_day > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
   (v8.3 INCR 전용, adf_script_v83_incr.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환
   + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성.
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건 반환

   대상 :
     Run Group(p_run_group_nm, RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상
     (vw_ingest_exec_target),
     p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능

   증분 조건 :
     증분컬럼 >= 시작일
     (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통.
      상한 없음, incr_to_val = NULL)

     pv_incr_from_val :
       p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값,
       없으면 오늘 - N 일
       (형식 yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd, 시각 있는 형식도 허용)

   증분컬럼 유형 :
     DATE / TIMESTAMP / STRING + 형식
     (PostgreSQL to_char 형식)
     그 외 유형은 즉시 실패

   DBX 전달 (GEN2) :
     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd.

     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 는
       range_column_nm = 증분컬럼,
       range_operator_cd = '>=',
       range_value = [YYYYMMDD]
       (월 형식 컬럼은 [YYYYMM])

   HWM :
     자식 수집 파이프라인이 갱신
     (이 스크립트는 관여 안 함)

   INCR 수집은 GEN2 기준으로 처리.

   ★ 변경 : INCR 수집 경로
     landing_path 없으면

       incr/
         frequency={frequency}/
           batch_datetime={YYYYMMDDHHMI}/

     frequency 표준화 :
       month   / monthly   -> monthly
       week    / weekly    -> weekly
       day     / daily     -> daily
       hour    / hourly    -> hourly
       minute  / minutely  -> minutely

     대소문자 구분 없음.

     예)
       incr/frequency=monthly/batch_datetime=202609281610
       incr/frequency=hourly/batch_datetime=202609281610

   ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명
     시퀀스(part) 위치는 항상 default

       {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.default.{ts}.parquet

     예)
       MLSQP.FSADM.MS_TBBMB9000.default.20260714070001.parquet

     FULL / 부분 Refresh 는 별도 FULL 로직에서
     202601, 2026 등의 실제 시퀀스 값을 사용

   즉시 실패
     (형변환 오류 -> Script 실패 -> Fail_master_run) :
       INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
       INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
       INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id

   수집 이력 INSERT 는
     Master RUNNING 전환 시에만 수행
     (SKIPPED Master 에서는 생성하지 않음)

   전역 skip 은 run_check 가 처리.

   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text
            AS run_group_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        '@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}'
            AS from_in,

        '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text
            AS batch_str,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 원본값 */
        '@{variables('pv_condition_unit')}'::text
            AS frequency_in,

        '@{if(
            pipeline().globalParameters.gp_pipeline_run_skip,
            'Y',
            'N'
        )}'::text
            AS skip_yn,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 0. 시작값 검증 / 변환 */
d AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        CASE
            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        19,
                        ':00'
                    ),
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{8}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{12}([0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        14,
                        '0'
                    ),
                    'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_timestamp(
                    (
                        'INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:'
                        || p.from_in
                    )::int::text,
                    'YYYY'
                )
        END::timestamp
            AS from_dt,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 표준화 */
        CASE lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

            WHEN 'month'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'monthly'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'week'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'weekly'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'day'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'daily'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'hour'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'hourly'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'minute'
                THEN 'minutely'

            WHEN 'minutely'
                THEN 'minutely'

            ELSE
                lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

        END::text
            AS frequency

    FROM p
),

/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT
        e.run_group_id,
        e.run_rule_id,
        m.*,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_db_nm
        ) AS ext_db_nm,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_schema_nm
        ) AS ext_schema_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.landing_path),
            ''
        ) AS landing_path_in,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.file_nm_template),
            ''
        ) AS file_nm_template_in

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
      ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
     AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = e.target_id

    WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL

       OR e.target_id IN (
            SELECT
                jsonb_array_elements_text(
                    p.target_ids
                )::bigint
       )
),

/* 2. 조건 / 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT
        t0.*,
        x.pl_nm,

        /* 기록용 시작값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND NULLIF(
                    trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    t0.incr_column_format
                )

            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

        END AS from_val,

        /* DBX 범위 값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMM'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

        END AS range_val,

        /* 증분 조건 */
        t0.incr_column_nm
        || ' >= '
        ||
        CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)

            WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN
                            'DATE('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD'
                               )
                            || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN
                            'CAST('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD'
                               )
                            || ''' AS DATE)'

                    ELSE
                        'DATE '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN
                            'TIMESTAMP('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                               )
                            || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN
                            'CAST('''
                            || to_char(
                                   d.from_dt,
                                   'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                               )
                            || ''' AS DATETIME2)'

                    ELSE
                        'TIMESTAMP '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(
                            trim(
                                t0.incr_column_format
                            ),
                            ''
                         ) IS NULL

                        THEN (
                            'INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:'
                            || t0.target_id
                        )::int::text

                    ELSE
                        ''''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               t0.incr_column_format
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            ELSE
                (
                    'INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:'
                    || t0.target_id
                )::int::text

        END AS cond_sql,

        /* ==========================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR Landing Path

           INCR GEN2 파일 수집 경로만 생성.

           사용자 지정 landing_path 토큰:
             {frequency}
             {batch_datetime}

           기본:
             incr/
               frequency=monthly|weekly|daily|hourly|minutely/
                 batch_datetime=YYYYMMDDHHMI/
           ========================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                             t0.landing_path_in,
                             '{frequency}',
                             d.frequency
                         ),
                         '{batch_datetime}',
                         left(
                             d.batch_str,
                             12
                         )
                     )

            ELSE
                'incr'
                || '/frequency='
                || d.frequency
                || '/batch_datetime='
                || left(
                       d.batch_str,
                       12
                   )

        END AS landing_path_out,

        /* ==========================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

           INCR GEN2 파일 기준.

           sequence(part) = default

           DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.default.TIMESTAMP.parquet
           ========================================================== */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 t0.file_nm_template_in,

                                 '{src_db}',
                                 t0.src_db_nm
                               ),

                               '{schema}',
                               t0.src_schema_nm
                             ),

                             '{table}',
                             t0.src_table_nm
                           ),

                           '{part}',
                           'default'
                         ),

                         '{ts}',
                         d.batch_str
                     )

            ELSE
                t0.src_db_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_table_nm
                || '.default.'
                || d.batch_str
                || '.parquet'

        END AS file_name_out

    FROM t0

    CROSS JOIN d

    /* 자식 수집 파이프라인 */
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            'pl_'
            || lower(t0.data_class)
            || '_ingest_'
            || lower(t0.src_type)
            || '_'
            || upper(t0.ext_db_nm)
                AS pl_nm
    ) x
),

/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt = now(),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
               FROM t
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'INCR',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
                THEN t.incr_load_method_cd
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN t.incr_column_nm
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN '>='
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    t.range_val
                )
        END,

        t.incr_policy_id,
        t.incr_column_nm,
        t.from_val,
        NULL,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(
                t.cdc_tgt_db_nm
            ),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(
                t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm
            ),
            ''
        ),

        t.data_class,

        /* 추출쿼리 */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(
                        t.src_query_template
                    ),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    t.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    t.cond_sql
                )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || t.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t.src_table_nm

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                           THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

                || ' WHERE '
                || t.cond_sql

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'
                           THEN ' WITH UR'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

        END,

        t.landing_path_out,
        t.file_name_out,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t

    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,
        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        range_value,
        status
)

/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    sink_type_cd,
    load_method_cd,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_from_val,
    range_value::text
        AS range_value,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY target_id;

activities.description: Master 종료 (수집 이력 집계)

text.value:
/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

activities.name: Fail_master_run
activities.description: Start_ingest 실패 -> Master FAILED

text.value:
/* Fail_master_run : Start_ingest_pipeline Script 실패 시. 수집 이력 INSERT 실패면 같은 문장의 RUNNING 전환도 취소되어 Master 는 PENDING 으로 남아 있음 */
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
   SET status          = 'FAILED',
       child_total_cnt = 0,
       child_succ_cnt  = 0,
       child_fail_cnt  = 0,
       error_log       = left('[Start_ingest_pipeline Script] '

activities.description: Master RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 (재시도 0)

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_incr_time > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
   (v8.3 INCR 전용, adf_script_v83_incr.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성.
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건 반환

   대상 :
     Run Group(p_run_group_nm, RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상
     (vw_ingest_exec_target),
     p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능

   증분 조건 :
     증분컬럼 >= 시작일
     (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통.
      상한 없음, incr_to_val = NULL)

     pv_incr_from_val :
       p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값,
       없으면 예정시각(p_scheduled_time, 없으면 현재)
       - N 분 또는 N 시간
       (형식 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss / yyyyMMddHHmm[ss])

   증분컬럼 유형 :
     DATE
       - 날짜 부분만 비교
     TIMESTAMP
       - 시각까지 비교
     STRING + 형식
       - 예 : yyyymmddhh24miss
     그 외 유형은 즉시 실패

   DBX 전달 (GEN2) :
     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd.

     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 는
       range_column_nm = 증분컬럼,
       range_operator_cd = '>=',
       range_value

     시각이 있는 컬럼
       TIMESTAMP 또는 HH 가 있는 STRING
       -> range_value = [YYYYMMDDHH24MISS]

   HWM :
     자식 수집 파이프라인이 갱신
     (이 스크립트는 관여 안 함)

   ★ 변경 : INCR 저장 경로

     landing_path 없으면

       incr/
         frequency={frequency}/
           batch_datetime={YYYYMMDDHHMI}/

     frequency 표준화 :
       month   / monthly   -> monthly
       week    / weekly    -> weekly
       day     / daily     -> daily
       hour    / hourly    -> hourly
       minute  / minutely  -> minutely

     대소문자 구분 없음

     예)
       incr/frequency=hourly/batch_datetime=202609281910
       incr/frequency=minutely/batch_datetime=202609281915

   ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

     sequence(part) 위치는 항상 default

       {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.default.{ts}.parquet

     예)
       MLSQP.FSADM.MS_TBBMB9002.default.20260928191501.parquet

   즉시 실패 :
     INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
     INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
     INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id

   수집 이력 INSERT 는 Master RUNNING 전환 시에만 수행.
   전역 skip 은 run_check 가 처리.

   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text
            AS run_group_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        '@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}'
            AS from_in,

        '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text
            AS batch_str,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 원본 */
        '@{variables('pv_condition_unit')}'::text
            AS frequency_in,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 0. 시작값 검증 / 변환 */
d AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        CASE
            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        19,
                        ':00'
                    ),
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{12}([0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(
                        p.from_in,
                        14,
                        '0'
                    ),
                    'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_timestamp(
                    (
                        'INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:'
                        || p.from_in
                    )::int::text,
                    'YYYY'
                )

        END::timestamp
            AS from_dt,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 표준화 */
        CASE lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

            WHEN 'month'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'monthly'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'week'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'weekly'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'day'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'daily'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'hour'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'hourly'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'minute'
                THEN 'minutely'

            WHEN 'minutely'
                THEN 'minutely'

            ELSE
                lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

        END::text
            AS frequency

    FROM p
),

/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT
        e.run_group_id,
        e.run_rule_id,
        m.*,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_db_nm
        ) AS ext_db_nm,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
                ''
            ),
            m.src_schema_nm
        ) AS ext_schema_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.landing_path),
            ''
        ) AS landing_path_in,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.file_nm_template),
            ''
        ) AS file_nm_template_in

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
      ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
     AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = e.target_id

    WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL
       OR e.target_id IN (
            SELECT
                jsonb_array_elements_text(
                    p.target_ids
                )::bigint
       )
),

/* 2. 조건 / 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT
        t0.*,
        x.pl_nm,

        /* 기록용 시작값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND NULLIF(
                    trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    t0.incr_column_format
                )

            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

        END AS from_val,

        /* DBX 범위 값 :
           TIMESTAMP 또는 HH 포함 STRING 은 시각까지 사용
        */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'
              OR (
                    upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
                AND t0.incr_column_format ILIKE '%HH%'
              )

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
                )

            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMM'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

        END AS range_val,

        t0.incr_column_nm
        || ' >= '
        ||
        CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)

            WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN 'DATE('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                                )
                             || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN 'CAST('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                                )
                             || ''' AS DATE)'

                    ELSE
                        'DATE '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN 'TIMESTAMP('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                                )
                             || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN 'CAST('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                                )
                             || ''' AS DATETIME2)'

                    ELSE
                        'TIMESTAMP '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            /* 문자형 날짜/시각 */
            WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(
                            trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                            ''
                         ) IS NULL

                        THEN (
                            'INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:'
                            || t0.target_id
                        )::int::text

                    ELSE
                        ''''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               t0.incr_column_format
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            /* 그 외 유형 -> Script 실패 */
            ELSE
                (
                    'INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:'
                    || t0.target_id
                )::int::text

        END AS cond_sql,

        /* ============================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 저장 경로

           기존:
             incr/
               batch_date=YYYYMMDD/
                 batch_hour=HH/
                   pipeline_name=...

           변경:
             incr/
               frequency=monthly|weekly|daily|hourly|minutely/
                 batch_datetime=YYYYMMDDHHMI/

           사용자 지정 landing_path 지원 토큰:
             {frequency}
             {batch_datetime}

           더 이상 사용하지 않음:
             {batch_date}
             {batch_hour}
             {pipeline_nm}
           ============================================================ */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                             t0.landing_path_in,
                             '{frequency}',
                             d.frequency
                         ),
                         '{batch_datetime}',
                         left(
                             d.batch_str,
                             12
                         )
                     )

            ELSE
                'incr'
                || '/frequency='
                || d.frequency
                || '/batch_datetime='
                || left(
                       d.batch_str,
                       12
                   )

        END AS landing_path_out,

        /* ============================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

           sequence(part) = default

           기본 파일명:
             DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.default.TIMESTAMP.parquet

           template 사용 시:
             {part} -> default
           ============================================================ */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 t0.file_nm_template_in,

                                 '{src_db}',
                                 t0.src_db_nm
                               ),

                               '{schema}',
                               t0.src_schema_nm
                             ),

                             '{table}',
                             t0.src_table_nm
                           ),

                           '{part}',
                           'default'
                         ),

                         '{ts}',
                         d.batch_str
                     )

            ELSE
                t0.src_db_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_table_nm
                || '.default.'
                || d.batch_str
                || '.parquet'

        END AS file_name_out

    FROM t0
    CROSS JOIN d

    /* 자식 파이프라인명 :
       pl_{data_class}_ingest_{src_type}_{추출 DB}
    */
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            'pl_'
            || lower(t0.data_class)
            || '_ingest_'
            || lower(t0.src_type)
            || '_'
            || upper(t0.ext_db_nm)
                AS pl_nm
    ) x
),

/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt = now(),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
               FROM t
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'INCR',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
                THEN t.incr_load_method_cd
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN t.incr_column_nm
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN '>='
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    t.range_val
                )
        END,

        t.incr_policy_id,
        t.incr_column_nm,
        t.from_val,
        NULL,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
            ''
        ),

        t.data_class,

        /* 추출쿼리 */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(t.src_query_template),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    t.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    t.cond_sql
                )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || t.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t.src_table_nm

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                           THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

                || ' WHERE '
                || t.cond_sql

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'
                           THEN ' WITH UR'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

        END,

        t.landing_path_out,
        t.file_name_out,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t
    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,

        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        range_value,
        status
)

/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,
    cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

    sink_type_cd,
    load_method_cd,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_from_val,
    range_value::text AS range_value,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY target_id;

text.value:
/* ============================================================================
   INCR HWM 갱신 스크립트 : pl_raw_orch_incr_* > ForEach_child_ingest
     흐름 : ... > pipeline_dispatcher (pl_dispatcher_ingest) --[Success]--> 이 Script

   전제 :
     자식 수집 파이프라인이 추출 데이터의 MAX(증분컬럼) 을
     ctl_ingest_pipeline_run.incr_to_val 에 기록한 뒤
     status='SUCCEEDED' 로 갱신함.

   HWM 적용값 :
     1) incr_to_val 이 NULL / 빈 문자열 / 공백이 아니면 incr_to_val
     2) incr_to_val 이 NULL / 빈 문자열 / 공백이면 incr_from_val
     3) 둘 다 없으면 기존 HWM 유지

   파라미터 :
     p_ingest_pipeline_id = @{item().ingest_pipeline_id}

   동작 :
     1) run_type_cd='INCR' AND status='SUCCEEDED' 인 이력만 대상
     2) incr_to_val 우선, 없으면 incr_from_val 로 HWM 갱신
     3) 둘 다 NULL / 공백이면 HWM 은 유지하고 last_success_dt 만 갱신

   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
============================================================================ */

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{item().ingest_pipeline_id}'::text
            AS ingest_pipeline_id
),

r AS (
    SELECT
        ipr.target_id,
        ipr.incr_column_nm,
        ipr.incr_from_val,
        ipr.incr_to_val,
        ipr.ingest_pipeline_id,

        /* ★ 변경 :
           incr_to_val 우선,
           NULL / 빈 문자열 / 공백이면 incr_from_val 사용
        */
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim(ipr.incr_to_val),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(
                trim(ipr.incr_from_val),
                ''
            )
        ) AS hw_val

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run ipr
      ON ipr.ingest_pipeline_id = p.ingest_pipeline_id

    WHERE ipr.run_type_cd = 'INCR'
      AND ipr.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
),

upd AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_incr_state s

       SET incr_column_nm = r.incr_column_nm,

           /* ★ 변경 :
              incr_to_val 없으면 incr_from_val 사용
              둘 다 없으면 기존 HWM 유지
           */
           incr_column_hw_val = COALESCE(
               r.hw_val,
               s.incr_column_hw_val
           ),

           last_success_dt = now(),

           /* ★ 변경 :
              실제 적용할 HWM 값이 있을 때 갱신
           */
           hw_updated_dt =
               CASE
                   WHEN r.hw_val IS NOT NULL
                       THEN now()
                   ELSE s.hw_updated_dt
               END,

           hw_ingest_pipeline_id =
               CASE
                   WHEN r.hw_val IS NOT NULL
                       THEN r.ingest_pipeline_id
                   ELSE s.hw_ingest_pipeline_id
               END,

           updated_dt = now()

      FROM r

     WHERE s.target_id = r.target_id

    RETURNING
        s.target_id
)

INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_incr_state
(
    target_id,
    incr_column_nm,
    incr_column_hw_val,
    last_success_dt,
    hw_updated_dt,
    hw_ingest_pipeline_id,
    updated_dt
)

SELECT
    r.target_id,
    r.incr_column_nm,

    /* ★ 변경 :
       incr_to_val 없으면 incr_from_val
    */
    r.hw_val,

    now(),

    CASE
        WHEN r.hw_val IS NOT NULL
            THEN now()
    END,

    CASE
        WHEN r.hw_val IS NOT NULL
            THEN r.ingest_pipeline_id
    END,

    now()

FROM r

WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM upd
    WHERE upd.target_id = r.target_id
)

AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_incr_state s2
    WHERE s2.target_id = r.target_id
);

/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_incr_month > Script "Start_ingest_pipeline Script"
   (v8.3 INCR 전용, adf_script_v83_incr.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING -> RUNNING 전환 + 수집 이력(ctl_ingest_pipeline_run) PENDING 생성.
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건 반환

   대상 :
     Run Group(p_run_group_nm, RAW_INCR) 의 INCR 대상
     (vw_ingest_exec_target),
     p_target_ids 로 일부만 수동 실행 가능

   증분 조건 :
     증분컬럼 >= 시작일
     (시작일 = pv_incr_from_val, 모든 대상 공통.
      상한 없음, incr_to_val = NULL)

     pv_incr_from_val :
       p_incr_from_val 이 있으면 그 값,
       없으면 (당월 - N 개월)의 1일
       (형식 yyyy-MM-dd / yyyyMMdd,
        월 형식 yyyyMM / yyyy-MM 은 파이프라인이 1일로 보정)

   증분컬럼 유형 :
     DATE / TIMESTAMP
       - 시작일 = 월 1일
     STRING + 형식
       - yyyymm   : col >= '202608'
       - yyyymmdd : col >= '20260801'
     그 외 유형은 즉시 실패

   DBX 전달 (GEN2) :
     load_method_cd = master.incr_load_method_cd.

     RANGE_DELETE_INSERT 는
       range_column_nm = 증분컬럼,
       range_operator_cd = '>=',
       range_value = [YYYYMMDD]
       (월 형식 컬럼은 [YYYYMM])

   HWM :
     자식 수집 파이프라인이 갱신
     (이 스크립트는 관여 안 함)

   ★ 변경 : INCR 저장 경로

     landing_path 없으면

       incr/
         frequency={frequency}/
           batch_datetime={YYYYMMDDHHMI}/

     frequency 표준화 :
       month   / monthly   -> monthly
       week    / weekly    -> weekly
       day     / daily     -> daily
       hour    / hourly    -> hourly
       minute  / minutely  -> minutely

     대소문자 구분 없음

     예)
       incr/frequency=monthly/batch_datetime=202609281610

   ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

     sequence(part) 위치는 항상 default

       {src_db}.{schema}.{table}.default.{ts}.parquet

     예)
       MLSQP.FSADM.MS_TBBMB9002.default.20260714073001.parquet

   즉시 실패 :
     INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:값
     INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:target_id
     INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:target_id

   수집 이력 INSERT 는 Master RUNNING 전환 시에만 수행.
   전역 skip 은 run_check 가 처리.
   Script 재시도 = 0.
   ADF 동적 식은 p CTE 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용.
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'::text
            AS run_group_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        '@{variables('pv_incr_from_val')}'
            AS from_in,

        '@{variables('pv_yyyyMMddHHmmss')}'::text
            AS batch_str,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 원본 */
        '@{variables('pv_condition_unit')}'::text
            AS frequency_in,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* 0. 시작값 검증 / 변환 */
d AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        CASE
            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~
                 '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(:[0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(p.from_in, 19, ':00'),
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{8}$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    p.from_in,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

            WHEN p.from_in ~ '^[0-9]{12}([0-9]{2})?$'
                THEN to_timestamp(
                    rpad(p.from_in, 14, '0'),
                    'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_timestamp(
                    (
                        'INCR_FROM_VAL_INVALID:'
                        || p.from_in
                    )::int::text,
                    'YYYY'
                )

        END::timestamp
            AS from_dt,

        /* ★ 변경 : frequency 표준화 */
        CASE lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

            WHEN 'month'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'monthly'
                THEN 'monthly'

            WHEN 'week'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'weekly'
                THEN 'weekly'

            WHEN 'day'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'daily'
                THEN 'daily'

            WHEN 'hour'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'hourly'
                THEN 'hourly'

            WHEN 'minute'
                THEN 'minutely'

            WHEN 'minutely'
                THEN 'minutely'

            ELSE
                lower(trim(p.frequency_in))

        END::text
            AS frequency

    FROM p
),

/* 1. 대상 + 추출 위치 */
t0 AS (
    SELECT
        e.run_group_id,
        e.run_rule_id,
        m.*,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),
            m.src_db_nm
        ) AS ext_db_nm,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''),
            m.src_schema_nm
        ) AS ext_schema_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.landing_path),
            ''
        ) AS landing_path_in,

        NULLIF(
            trim(m.file_nm_template),
            ''
        ) AS file_nm_template_in

    FROM p

    JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
      ON e.run_group_nm = p.run_group_nm
     AND e.run_type_cd = 'INCR'

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
      ON m.target_id = e.target_id

    WHERE p.target_ids IS NULL
       OR e.target_id IN (
            SELECT
                jsonb_array_elements_text(
                    p.target_ids
                )::bigint
       )
),

/* 2. 조건 / 자식 파이프라인명 / 경로 / 파일명 */
t AS (
    SELECT
        t0.*,
        x.pl_nm,

        /* 기록용 시작값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND NULLIF(
                    trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    t0.incr_column_format
                )

            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'TIMESTAMP'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                )

        END AS from_val,

        /* DBX 범위 값 */
        CASE
            WHEN upper(t0.incr_column_type) = 'STRING'
             AND t0.incr_column_format NOT ILIKE '%DD%'

                THEN to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMM'
                )

            ELSE
                to_char(
                    d.from_dt,
                    'YYYYMMDD'
                )

        END AS range_val,

        t0.incr_column_nm
        || ' >= '
        ||
        CASE upper(t0.incr_column_type)

            WHEN 'DATE' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN 'DATE('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                                )
                             || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN 'CAST('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD'
                                )
                             || ''' AS DATE)'

                    ELSE
                        'DATE '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN
                CASE upper(t0.src_type)

                    WHEN 'DB2'
                        THEN 'TIMESTAMP('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                                )
                             || ''')'

                    WHEN 'MSSQL'
                        THEN 'CAST('''
                             || to_char(
                                    d.from_dt,
                                    'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                                )
                             || ''' AS DATETIME2)'

                    ELSE
                        'TIMESTAMP '''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            WHEN 'STRING' THEN
                CASE
                    WHEN NULLIF(
                            trim(t0.incr_column_format),
                            ''
                         ) IS NULL

                        THEN (
                            'INCR_COL_FORMAT_MISSING:'
                            || t0.target_id
                        )::int::text

                    ELSE
                        ''''
                        || to_char(
                               d.from_dt,
                               t0.incr_column_format
                           )
                        || ''''

                END

            ELSE
                (
                    'INCR_COL_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED:'
                    || t0.target_id
                )::int::text

        END AS cond_sql,

        /* ============================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 저장 경로

           기존:
             incr/
               batch_date=YYYYMMDD/
                 batch_hour=HH/
                   pipeline_name=...

           변경:
             incr/
               frequency=monthly|weekly|daily|hourly|minutely/
                 batch_datetime=YYYYMMDDHHMI/

           사용자 지정 landing_path 지원 토큰:
             {frequency}
             {batch_datetime}

           {batch_date}, {batch_hour}, {pipeline_nm} 제거
           ============================================================ */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.landing_path_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                             t0.landing_path_in,
                             '{frequency}',
                             d.frequency
                         ),
                         '{batch_datetime}',
                         left(
                             d.batch_str,
                             12
                         )
                     )

            ELSE
                'incr'
                || '/frequency='
                || d.frequency
                || '/batch_datetime='
                || left(
                       d.batch_str,
                       12
                   )

        END AS landing_path_out,

        /* ============================================================
           ★ 변경 : INCR 파일명

           sequence(part)는 항상 default

           DB.SCHEMA.TABLE.default.TIMESTAMP.parquet

           template 사용 시:
             {part} -> default
           ============================================================ */
        CASE
            WHEN t0.sink_type_cd <> 'GEN2'
                THEN NULL

            WHEN t0.file_nm_template_in IS NOT NULL
                THEN replace(
                         replace(
                           replace(
                             replace(
                               replace(
                                 t0.file_nm_template_in,

                                 '{src_db}',
                                 t0.src_db_nm
                               ),

                               '{schema}',
                               t0.src_schema_nm
                             ),

                             '{table}',
                             t0.src_table_nm
                           ),

                           '{part}',
                           'default'
                         ),

                         '{ts}',
                         d.batch_str
                     )

            ELSE
                t0.src_db_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t0.src_table_nm
                || '.default.'
                || d.batch_str
                || '.parquet'

        END AS file_name_out

    FROM t0
    CROSS JOIN d

    /* 자식 파이프라인명 */
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            'pl_'
            || lower(t0.data_class)
            || '_ingest_'
            || lower(t0.src_type)
            || '_'
            || upper(t0.ext_db_nm)
                AS pl_nm
    ) x
),

/* 3. Master 이력 PENDING -> RUNNING */
mst AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m

       SET status = 'RUNNING',
           start_dt = now(),
           updated_by = p.created_by,
           updated_dt = now(),

           child_total_cnt = (
               SELECT count(*)
               FROM t
           )

      FROM p

     WHERE m.master_run_id = p.master_run_id
       AND m.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        m.master_run_id
),

/* 4. 수집 이력 PENDING 생성 */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        run_group_id,
        run_rule_id,
        target_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        run_type_cd,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,
        range_column_nm,
        range_operator_cd,
        range_value,

        incr_policy_id,
        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        incr_to_val,

        src_type,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,
        data_class,

        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    SELECT
        p.master_run_id,
        t.run_group_id,
        t.run_rule_id,
        t.target_id,
        t.pl_nm,
        'INCR',

        t.sink_type_cd,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
                THEN t.incr_load_method_cd
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN t.incr_column_nm
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN '>='
        END,

        CASE
            WHEN t.sink_type_cd = 'GEN2'
             AND t.incr_load_method_cd = 'RANGE_DELETE_INSERT'
                THEN jsonb_build_array(
                    t.range_val
                )
        END,

        t.incr_policy_id,
        t.incr_column_nm,
        t.from_val,
        NULL,

        t.src_type,
        t.src_db_nm,
        t.src_schema_nm,
        t.src_table_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_db_nm),
            ''
        ),

        NULLIF(
            trim(t.cdc_tgt_schema_nm),
            ''
        ),

        t.data_class,

        /* 추출쿼리 */
        CASE
            WHEN NULLIF(
                    trim(t.src_query_template),
                    ''
                 ) IS NOT NULL

                THEN replace(
                    t.src_query_template,
                    '{WHERE}',
                    t.cond_sql
                )

            ELSE
                'SELECT * FROM '
                || t.ext_schema_nm
                || '.'
                || t.src_table_nm

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'MSSQL'
                           THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

                || ' WHERE '
                || t.cond_sql

                || CASE
                       WHEN upper(t.src_type) = 'DB2'
                           THEN ' WITH UR'
                       ELSE ''
                   END

        END,

        t.landing_path_out,
        t.file_name_out,

        'PENDING',
        p.created_by

    FROM t
    CROSS JOIN p

    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mst
    )

    RETURNING
        ingest_pipeline_id,
        master_run_id,
        ingest_pipeline_nm,
        extract_query,
        landing_path,
        file_name,

        target_id,
        src_db_nm,
        src_schema_nm,
        src_table_nm,

        cdc_tgt_db_nm,
        cdc_tgt_schema_nm,

        sink_type_cd,
        load_method_cd,

        incr_column_nm,
        incr_from_val,
        range_value,
        status
)

/* 5. ForEach 입력 */
SELECT
    ingest_pipeline_id,
    master_run_id,
    ingest_pipeline_nm,
    extract_query,

    COALESCE(
        landing_path,
        ''
    ) AS landing_path,

    COALESCE(
        file_name,
        ''
    ) AS file_name,

    target_id,
    src_db_nm,
    src_schema_nm,
    src_table_nm,
    cdc_tgt_db_nm,

    sink_type_cd,

    incr_column_nm,
    incr_from_val,
    range_value::text AS range_value,
    status

FROM ins

ORDER BY target_id;

/* End_master_run : ForEach 완료 시 (성공 / 실패 모두). RUNNING 인 Master 만 갱신 (Fail_master_run 이 바꾼 행 · SKIPPED 는 유지)
   종료 시점에 RUNNING / PENDING 으로 남은 수집 행은 실패로 집계 */
WITH c AS (
    SELECT count(*)                                                        AS total_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED')                    AS succ_cnt,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('FAILED','RUNNING','PENDING')) AS fail_cnt
      FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
     WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
       AND status <> 'SKIPPED'
)
UPDATE adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
   SET child_total_cnt = c.total_cnt,
       child_succ_cnt  = c.succ_cnt,
       child_fail_cnt  = c.fail_cnt,
       status          = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN 'SUCCEEDED' ELSE 'FAILED' END,
       error_log       = CASE WHEN c.fail_cnt = 0 THEN m.error_log
                              ELSE '수집 실패 ' || c.fail_cnt || '건 (ctl_ingest_pipeline_run 확인)' END,
       end_dt          = now(),
       updated_by      = '@{pipeline().DataFactory}',
       updated_dt      = now()
  FROM c
 WHERE m.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
   AND m.status = 'RUNNING';

text.value:
/* pl_raw_orch_init > Script "Ins_master_run"
   (v8.3 개정 3, adf_script_v83_master_ins_init.sql 기반)

   Master PENDING 등록
   (+ REQUEST 는 재수집 요청 확보)

   진입 방식 :

     A. INIT_LOAD

        A-1. p_init_load_group 값 있음
             -> ctl_ingest_target_master.init_load_group = p_init_load_group
             -> init_wait_yn = 'Y' 대상만 수집

        A-2. p_init_load_group NULL
             -> init_wait_yn = 'N' 대상만 수집

        단, p_run_group_nm 이 없고 p_request_yn <> 'Y' 인 경우
        INIT_LOAD 진입으로 판단

     B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH

        p_run_group_nm 값 있음
        -> RAW_REFRESH Run Group 경유

        p_run_type_override = PARTIAL_REFRESH
           -> PARTIAL_REFRESH

        그 외
           -> FULL_REFRESH

     C. REQUEST

        p_request_yn = 'Y'
        -> PENDING 재수집 요청 확보

   진입 방식은 정확히 하나만 허용

   검증 실패 :
     형변환 오류로 활동 실패
     Master 행 생성 안 됨

   같은 master_run_id 재실행 시 무시
     ON CONFLICT (master_run_id) DO NOTHING

   Trigger명 :
     p_trigger_nm 우선

   p_entry_run_id :
     entry_run_id 에 기록

   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용.
   주석은 블록 주석만 사용
*/

WITH p AS (
    SELECT
        '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text
            AS master_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'::text
            AS pipeline_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_init_load_group}'),
            ''
        )
            AS init_load_group,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_group_nm}'),
            ''
        )
            AS run_group_nm,

        upper(
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_request_yn}'),
                    ''
                ),
                'N'
            )
        ) = 'Y'
            AS request_yn,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_scheduled_time}'),
            ''
        )::timestamptz
            AS scheduled_dt,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_target_ids}'),
            ''
        )::jsonb
            AS target_ids,

        upper(
            NULLIF(
                trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_run_type_override}'),
                ''
            )
        )
            AS run_type_override,

        '@{pipeline().TriggerType}'::text
            AS trigger_type,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(
                trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_trigger_nm}'),
                ''
            ),
            NULLIF(
                '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',
                ''
            ),
            'Manual'
        )
            AS trigger_nm,

        NULLIF(
            trim('@{pipeline().parameters.p_entry_run_id}'),
            ''
        )
            AS entry_run_id,

        '@{pipeline().DataFactory}'::text
            AS created_by
),

/* ================================================================
   진입 방식 판정

   INIT_LOAD :
     p_run_group_nm IS NULL
     AND p_request_yn <> Y

   p_init_load_group 은 INIT_LOAD 내부의 선택 조건이며
   값이 없어도 INIT_LOAD 진입 가능

   충돌 예 :
     p_init_load_group + p_run_group_nm
     p_init_load_group + REQUEST
     p_run_group_nm + REQUEST
   ================================================================ */
e AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,

        (
            (
                p.init_load_group IS NOT NULL

                OR (
                    p.run_group_nm IS NULL
                    AND NOT p.request_yn
                )
            )::int

            + (p.run_group_nm IS NOT NULL)::int

            + p.request_yn::int

        ) AS entry_cnt

    FROM p
),

/* ================================================================
   A. INIT_LOAD

   p_init_load_group 값 있음 :
     init_load_group 일치
     AND init_wait_yn = 'Y'

   p_init_load_group NULL :
     init_wait_yn = 'N'

   target_ids 지정 시 해당 Target 존재 여부까지 검증
   ================================================================ */
ga AS (
    SELECT
        e.*

    FROM e

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NULL

      AND NOT e.request_yn

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1

          FROM adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m

          WHERE m.delete_yn = 'N'

            AND (
                    (
                        e.init_load_group IS NOT NULL

                        AND m.init_load_group = e.init_load_group

                        AND upper(
                                COALESCE(
                                    NULLIF(
                                        trim(m.init_wait_yn),
                                        ''
                                    ),
                                    'N'
                                )
                            ) = 'Y'
                    )

                    OR

                    (
                        e.init_load_group IS NULL

                        AND upper(
                                COALESCE(
                                    NULLIF(
                                        trim(m.init_wait_yn),
                                        ''
                                    ),
                                    'N'
                                )
                            ) = 'N'
                    )
                )

            AND (
                    e.target_ids IS NULL

                    OR m.target_id IN (
                        SELECT
                            jsonb_array_elements_text(
                                e.target_ids
                            )::bigint
                    )
                )
      )
),

/* ================================================================
   B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH

   p_run_group_nm 을 받으면 RAW_REFRESH 그룹으로 실행

   p_run_type_override = PARTIAL_REFRESH
     -> PARTIAL_REFRESH

   그 외
     -> FULL_REFRESH
   ================================================================ */
gb AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        g.run_group_id

    FROM e

    JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_run_group g
      ON g.run_group_nm = e.run_group_nm
     AND g.enabled_yn = 'Y'
     AND g.job_type_cd = 'RAW_REFRESH'

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NOT NULL

      AND NOT e.request_yn

      AND e.init_load_group IS NULL
),

/* ================================================================
   C. REQUEST
   ================================================================ */
gc AS (
    SELECT
        e.*

    FROM e

    WHERE e.entry_cnt = 1

      AND e.request_yn

      AND e.run_group_nm IS NULL

      AND e.init_load_group IS NULL
),

/* 확보할 PENDING 요청 */
req AS (
    SELECT
        q.request_id

    FROM adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q

    JOIN gc
      ON TRUE

    WHERE q.status = 'PENDING'

      AND q.refresh_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'

      AND (
              gc.target_ids IS NULL

              OR q.target_id IN (
                  SELECT
                      jsonb_array_elements_text(
                          gc.target_ids
                      )::bigint
              )
          )
),

/* ================================================================
   Master PENDING 등록
   ================================================================ */
ins AS (
    INSERT INTO adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run
    (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        trigger_type_cd,
        adf_trigger_nm,
        scheduled_dt,

        run_group_id,
        init_load_group,
        run_type_override_cd,
        run_param,

        entry_run_id,

        status,
        created_by
    )

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       A. INIT_LOAD

       init_load_group 값 있음
         -> init_wait_yn = Y 대상

       init_load_group NULL
         -> init_wait_yn = N 대상

       run_param 에 init_wait_yn 도 기록
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        ga.master_run_id,
        ga.pipeline_nm,

        'INIT_LOAD',

        ga.trigger_nm,
        ga.scheduled_dt,

        NULL,

        ga.init_load_group,

        NULL,

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'init_load_group',
                ga.init_load_group,

                'init_wait_yn',
                CASE
                    WHEN ga.init_load_group IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 'Y'
                    ELSE
                        'N'
                END,

                'target_ids',
                ga.target_ids
            )
        ),

        ga.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        ga.created_by

    FROM ga

    UNION ALL

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       B. FULL_REFRESH / PARTIAL_REFRESH
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        gb.master_run_id,
        gb.pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN gb.trigger_type = 'Manual'
                THEN 'MANUAL'
            ELSE
                'SCHEDULE'
        END,

        gb.trigger_nm,
        gb.scheduled_dt,

        gb.run_group_id,

        NULL,

        CASE
            WHEN gb.run_type_override = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
        END,

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'target_ids',
                gb.target_ids,

                'run_type_override',
                CASE
                    WHEN gb.run_type_override = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                        THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                    ELSE
                        'FULL_REFRESH'
                END
            )
        ),

        gb.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        gb.created_by

    FROM gb

    UNION ALL

    /* --------------------------------------------------------------
       C. REQUEST
       -------------------------------------------------------------- */
    SELECT
        gc.master_run_id,
        gc.pipeline_nm,

        CASE
            WHEN gc.trigger_type = 'Manual'
                THEN 'MANUAL'
            ELSE
                'SCHEDULE'
        END,

        gc.trigger_nm,
        gc.scheduled_dt,

        NULL,
        NULL,

        'REQUEST',

        jsonb_strip_nulls(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'request',
                true,

                'target_ids',
                gc.target_ids,

                'request_cnt',
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM req
                )
            )
        ),

        gc.entry_run_id,

        'PENDING',
        gc.created_by

    FROM gc

    ON CONFLICT (master_run_id)
    DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        master_run_id,
        trigger_type_cd,
        adf_trigger_nm,
        run_group_id,
        init_load_group,
        run_type_override_cd,
        run_param,
        status
),

/* ================================================================
   C. 요청 확보
   Master 가 새로 등록된 경우만

   동시 실행 시 다른 실행이 먼저 확보한 요청 제외
   ================================================================ */
claim AS (
    UPDATE adfadm.ctl_refresh_request q

       SET status = 'RUNNING',

           master_run_id = i.master_run_id,

           updated_by = (
               SELECT created_by
               FROM p
           ),

           updated_dt = now()

      FROM ins i

     WHERE i.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'

       AND q.request_id IN (
           SELECT request_id
           FROM req
       )

       AND q.status = 'PENDING'

    RETURNING
        q.request_id
)

/* ================================================================
   결과
   ================================================================ */
SELECT
    i.master_run_id,
    i.trigger_type_cd,
    i.adf_trigger_nm,
    i.run_group_id,
    i.init_load_group,
    i.run_type_override_cd,

    i.run_param::text
        AS run_param,

    i.status,

    (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM claim
    ) AS request_cnt,

    /* 검증 실패
       -> 형변환 오류로 활동 실패
       -> Master 행 생성 안 됨
    */
    CASE
        WHEN (
            SELECT entry_cnt
            FROM e
        ) <> 1

            THEN (
                'ENTRY_PARAM_INVALID:'
                ||
                (
                    SELECT
                        COALESCE(init_load_group, '')
                        || '/'
                        || COALESCE(run_group_nm, '')
                        || '/'
                        || request_yn::text
                    FROM p
                )
            )::int

        /* INIT_LOAD 대상 없음
           - 그룹 지정 시 init_wait_yn = Y 대상 없음
           - 그룹 미지정 시 init_wait_yn = N 대상 없음
        */
        WHEN (
                SELECT run_group_nm
                FROM p
             ) IS NULL

         AND NOT (
                SELECT request_yn
                FROM p
             )

         AND (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM ga
             ) = 0

            THEN (
                CASE
                    WHEN (
                        SELECT init_load_group
                        FROM p
                    ) IS NOT NULL

                        THEN
                            'INIT_LOAD_GROUP_OR_WAIT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND:'
                            || (
                                SELECT init_load_group
                                FROM p
                            )

                    ELSE
                        'INIT_LOAD_READY_TARGET_NOT_FOUND:init_wait_yn=N'
                END
            )::int

        WHEN (
                SELECT run_group_nm
                FROM p
             ) IS NOT NULL

         AND (
                SELECT count(*)
                FROM gb
             ) = 0

            THEN (
                'RUN_GROUP_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_REFRESH:'
                || (
                    SELECT run_group_nm
                    FROM p
                )
            )::int

        ELSE
            1

    END AS chk

FROM (
    SELECT 1
) d

LEFT JOIN ins i
  ON TRUE;

text.value:
/* Prepare_src_lookup : 원천조회(PART) 가 필요한 Target 과 조회 쿼리. init.sql 의 파티션 값 결정 중 LOOKUP_ALL / LOOKUP_FROM 에 해당하는 대상만
     LOOKUP_ALL  : FULL_REFRESH + partition_clause 있음 (원천조회 전체), INIT_LOAD 에서 목록(partition_val 원소 1개 이상) · 변수 목록 · 시작+끝 이 모두 없는 경우
     LOOKUP_FROM / LOOKUP_TO : 시작값만 / 끝값만(INIT_LOAD 만) 지정한 경우. REQUEST 제외
   Master 가 PENDING 이 아니면 (SKIPPED 등) 0건. 조회 위치 = 추출 위치 (cdc_tgt_* 우선)
   ADF 동적 식은 p 에만 사용. 주석은 블록 주석만 사용 */
WITH p AS (
    SELECT '@{pipeline().RunId}'::text                           AS master_run_id,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_start_val')}'), '')      AS start_in,
           NULLIF(trim('@{variables('pv_end_val')}'), '')        AS end_in,
           NULLIF(NULLIF(regexp_replace('@{variables('pv_partition_val')}', '\s', '', 'g'), ''), '[]')::jsonb AS list_in
),
master_src AS (
    SELECT m.master_run_id, m.run_group_id, m.init_load_group,
           m.run_param -> 'target_ids' AS target_ids,
           (m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST') IS TRUE AS req_yn,
           CASE WHEN m.run_type_override_cd = 'REQUEST'  THEN 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
                WHEN m.run_type_override_cd IS NOT NULL THEN m.run_type_override_cd
                WHEN m.init_load_group      IS NOT NULL THEN 'INIT_LOAD'
                ELSE 'FULL_REFRESH' END AS run_type_cd
      FROM adfadm.ctl_master_pipeline_run m
      JOIN p ON p.master_run_id = m.master_run_id
     WHERE m.status = 'PENDING'
),
target_src AS (
    SELECT m.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m
        ON m.init_load_group = r.init_load_group AND m.delete_yn = 'N'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR m.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.target_id, r.run_type_cd
      FROM master_src r
      JOIN adfadm.vw_ingest_exec_target e
        ON e.run_group_id = r.run_group_id AND e.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
     WHERE r.run_type_cd <> 'INIT_LOAD' AND NOT r.req_yn
       AND (r.target_ids IS NULL OR e.target_id IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(r.target_ids)::bigint))
),
d AS (
    SELECT t.run_type_cd, m.target_id, m.src_type,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_db_nm), ''),     m.src_db_nm)     AS ext_db_nm,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(m.cdc_tgt_schema_nm), ''), m.src_schema_nm) AS ext_schema_nm,
           m.src_table_nm, m.partition_clause,
           m.partition_clause ->> 'partition_column' AS part_col,
           m.partition_clause -> 'partition_val'     AS part_list
      FROM target_src t
      JOIN adfadm.ctl_ingest_target_master m ON m.target_id = t.target_id
)
SELECT d.target_id, d.ext_db_nm, d.ext_schema_nm, d.src_type, d.part_col,
       'SELECT DISTINCT ' || d.part_col || ' AS LOOKUP_VAL FROM ' || d.ext_schema_nm || '.' || d.src_table_nm
       || CASE upper(d.src_type) WHEN 'DB2' THEN ' WITH UR' WHEN 'MSSQL' THEN ' WITH (NOLOCK)' ELSE '' END AS lookup_query
  FROM d CROSS JOIN p
 WHERE d.partition_clause IS NOT NULL AND d.part_col IS NOT NULL
   AND (   d.run_type_cd = 'FULL_REFRESH'
        /* INIT_LOAD : 목록(원소 1개 이상) / 변수 목록 / 시작 + 끝 이 아니면 원천조회 (시작값만 / 끝값만 / 없음) */
        OR (    d.run_type_cd = 'INIT_LOAD'
            AND NOT (jsonb_typeof(d.part_list) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(d.part_list) >= 1)
            AND p.list_in IS NULL
            AND NOT (p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NOT NULL))
        /* PARTIAL_REFRESH : 시작값만 지정한 경우 */
        OR (    d.run_type_cd = 'PARTIAL_REFRESH'
            AND p.list_in IS NULL AND p.start_in IS NOT NULL AND p.end_in IS NULL))
 ORDER BY d.target_id;
